message.content: Maaf, saya perlu memastikan identitas Anda terlebih dahulu. Bisa tolong berikan username dan password Anda? Jika Anda tidak ingin membagikannya di sini, silakan lakukan login melalui aplikasi atau situs resmi kami. Setelah terautentikasi, saya akan cek status pesanan “pants” Anda.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Kak, untuk pants itu ready tidak ya". This is Indonesian: "Kak, for pants, is it ready or not?" They want to know if the pants are ready. We need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. The tool is for authentication. But we don't have username/password. So we cannot call the function. We should ask for credentials. The user might want to check status. We can respond asking for login.
